name: Modern SEO - M2L4 Putting it All Together
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-22

Part of: [Modern SEO - Module 2 Three-Step Method](lib:brain-modern-seo-module-2-three-step-method) | [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course) | [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index)

# Summary
Timelines, the success measure and the Core 30 decision point (4:18). The three steps can be implemented in 1 to 2 weeks; results take longer and come unevenly. The target is 20 to 40% top 3 green coverage, usually within 1 to 2 months in low to medium competition markets.

# Key concepts
- **Implementation timeline:** GBP audit in one session; landing page the same or next day; citation tool setup about 10 minutes.
- **Results timeline:** movement within a couple of weeks; faster with a chamber of commerce membership, the instructor's offsite analysis prompt and local charity sponsorships.
- **Progress is uneven** (example: gains in week 3, nothing for two weeks, a jump in week 5).
- **Decision:** steady growth to 30, 40 or 50% means the three steps are enough. Stuck at 10 to 15% after two months means the market needs Core 30. "Your rank map will tell you."
- **Not a failure:** the foundation is still built; Core 30 layers on top.
- **Top 3 is what counts:** "Fourth position or lower is basically invisible."
- **Discipline:** track every 1 to 2 weeks (not more often), document every change with its date, and do not add random tactics.

# Checklist
- Three steps implemented within 1 to 2 weeks.
- Offsite extras considered.
- Rank map checked every 1 to 2 weeks; dated change log kept.
- Two-month check against the 20 to 40% target; decision recorded.

# Notable quote
- "Don't start adding random tactics if you don't see results in a day or two. Stick to the system."

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Record a baseline top 3 coverage and a review date for [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub), [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub) and [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub); Kim's visibility tracker could hold the readings.
- Keep a dated change log of every [Google Business Profile](lib:brain-google-business-profile), landing page and citation change.
- Two-month test: a client stuck around 10 to 15% gets flagged to Kim as a Core 30 candidate ([Modern SEO - M3L1 What the Core 30 Framework Is](lib:brain-modern-seo-m3l1-what-the-core-30-framework-is)).
- Chamber membership and charity sponsorship cost money; raise with Kim and Scott for approval.
- Use the framing to set client expectations: quick to implement, weeks to show results, uneven progress.

# Caveats and open questions
- All timelines and percentages, including "enough for 70 to 80% of businesses," are instructor claims.
- Speech vs slide differences: "every one to two weeks" vs "every two weeks"; "a day or two" vs "immediate results."
- The offsite analysis prompt is not shown; it is on the course page. The lesson previews Module 4 ([Modern SEO - Module 4 Client Acquisition and Pricing](lib:brain-modern-seo-module-4-client-acquisition-and-pricing)).
